prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1270; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision in Katy, Texas?
A: Yes, I was driving. I was the one making the left turn.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you approached the intersection.
A: I was heading east on the main road and wanted to turn left into the shopping center. The light had turned yellow, then I think it went green for me. I checked for oncoming traffic, saw the lane was clear, and started my turn.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before impact?
A: Not really. I remember a flash of headlights to my right and then the airbag went off. I didn't see it coming until it was on me.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: How fast were you traveling when you began the turn?
A: Probably around twenty-five. I wasn't rushing.
Q: After the impact, what symptoms did you notice?
A: I had a bad headache right away and felt dizzy. The light in the car seemed too bright, and I felt nauseous. My neck started hurting later that evening.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, I was taken by ambulance to the hospital. They told me I have a concussion and I've been told to rest and avoid screens for a while.
Q: Have you experienced any memory problems or trouble concentrating since the accident?
A: Yes, I've had trouble focusing at work and I forget things more than I used to.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I believe I followed all the traffic rules. I was careful, and I want my medical bills taken care of.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
